mapper.select: SELECT acl_id, ip_addr, list_type, description, use_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM admin_ip_acl ORDER BY acl_id DESC
SELECT acl_id, ip_addr, list_type, description, use_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip, mod_dt, mod_id, mod_ip FROM admin_ip_acl WHERE acl_id = #{aclId}
SELECT ip_addr FROM admin_ip_acl WHERE list_type = #{listType} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_ip_acl (ip_addr, list_type, description, use_yn, reg_dt, reg_id, reg_ip) VALUES (#{ipAddr}, #{listType}, #{description}, #{useYn}, #{regDt}, #{regId}, #{regIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_ip_acl SET ip_addr = #{ipAddr}, list_type = #{listType}, description = #{description}, use_yn = #{useYn}, mod_dt = #{modDt}, mod_id = #{modId}, mod_ip = #{modIp} WHERE acl_id = #{aclId}
mapper.select: SELECT policy_mode FROM admin_ip_policy WHERE policy_id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_ip_policy SET policy_mode = #{policyMode}, mod_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, mod_id = #{modId} WHERE policy_id = 1
